text_block_list.text:
"From the spring of our first meeting—to 
the autumn of reckoning. It is the day of 
our decisive battle, the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Scarlet. The day has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm really glad to have you in my 
generation."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What's this? Flattery out of nowhere?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's not it. It's precisely because you 
are the ideal number one that surpassing 
you actually means something.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Because I can show 'em there's a cooler 
way to live than just being number one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I can't show you. Because I just 
can't win.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, your feistiness hasn't changed a 
bit. Not one tiny bit since the day we 
met."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"We're both guilty of it. Though I'm glad 
we're both so stubborn."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If either of them had been weak and 
pliable... they would've been dragged 
along by the other's way of life, wouldn't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And then, it would've been ruined. One of 
them, surely, by about now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. It's precisely because we didn't 
give way that we have today. And the time 
that begins right now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, we're totally hopeless. Hopelessly 
the best, that is!"

The showdown begins. A clash between two 
who ran together, neither willing to back 
down.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Here I come! It wouldn't mean anything to 
be number one without beating you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm gonna beat you at your best! In 
the absolute coolest way I've ever done 
it!!
